commit.message:
docs: point the data DOI at version 1.3.0 and fix the WorkflowHub relation

- data DOI updated in README, REPRODUCIBILITY, scripts/README and
  build_combined_proteome.sh: 10.5281/zenodo.22147977 -> 10.5281/zenodo.22150587
- .zenodo.json: WorkflowHub relation isIdenticalTo -> isVersionOf, since the
  registration froze commit a4ab11c and this repository has moved past it
